name: Gloomhaven: Jaws of the Lion

categories.label: Scenario completed (goal achieved)
categories.hint: Failed if all characters become exhausted; then the scenario is replayed from the start.

categories.label: Experience gained (blue dial + completion bonus)
categories.hint: Blue-dial XP plus the completion bonus (6 XP in the tutorial scenarios; later by scenario level per full rulebook).

categories.label: Gold gained
categories.hint: Money tokens x conversion (2 gold each in the tutorial scenarios) plus scenario reward gold.

categories.label: Battle goal checkmarks earned
categories.hint: Earned only on a completed scenario; every 3 checkmarks give a perk.

winCondition: Party achieves the goal in the scenario book before every character is exhausted. A failed scenario is replayed; XP, money and looted treasure earned in the failed attempt are kept.

endCondition.description: Scenario goal reached, or all characters exhausted (failure).

notes: family: coop. No points; progress is campaign-sheet based. Verified only against the tutorial Learn-to-Play book (pp.16, 18, 23); the full rules for the scenario-level gold/XP table and end-of-scenario sequence were not available, so conversion numbers are entered by the scorer. Solo mode not modelled.
